summary: Tested the new Student Digital Card feature end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_student_cards.py (21 pytest cases) covering card payload, per-faculty template settings (green/dark/horizontal + 400 on invalid), admin photo upload (immediate), student self-upload (pending) + pending list + approve/reject, public verify (active=valid / alumni=لم تعد سارية / random token=invalid), public card photo, PNG/PDF download for all 3 templates (magic bytes verified), and QR resolution by card_token and legacy qr_code. ALL 21 PASSED. Frontend (Playwright, admin admin/admin123): login -> /student-details -> 'البطاقة' navigates to /student-card and renders digital card (dark template) with name, QR, validity strip; تنزيل صورة downloaded card_1001.png (79KB) and تنزيل PDF downloaded card_1001.pdf (83KB); تصميم البطاقة opens /card-settings with 3 template options, selection + حفظ التصميم shows success msg and persists after reload (card re-renders in horizontal layout); /reports shows both 'سجل الإفادات' and 'اعتماد صور الطلاب' cards and navigation works; /photo-approvals listed the pending photo for خالد and 'اعتماد' approved it (count 1 -> 0 with empty state); public /verify-card?token=... works without login for valid, alumni and random tokens.

integration_issues.flow: Public QR verify link / new routes
integration_issues.issue: Direct HTTP load of /verify-card, /card-settings and /photo-approvals returns HTTP status 404 (page still renders via SPA fallback). Root cause: /app/frontend/dist static export is stale — verify-card.html, card-settings.html, photo-approvals.html do not exist (student-card.html and reports.html do, and those return 200). In a production/static deploy the public QR verify URL would hard-404. Re-run the web export/build after adding the new routes.

issues: QR code sits very close to the data column (رقم القيد/التخصص rows) leaving almost no gutter; consider more spacing or moving QR below the data block
Horizontal card has no 'امسح الرمز للتحقق' hint text next to the QR (present in vertical templates)

action_items: Regenerate the Expo web export (/app/frontend/dist) so verify-card, card-settings and photo-approvals routes exist as static entries — currently the public verify URL returns HTTP 404 status on direct load
Optional: improve QR spacing in the horizontal card template
critical_code_review_comments: student_cards.py: data-testid props declared on RN View/Text components are NOT emitted in the DOM by react-native-web (verified: zero [data-testid] elements on every page, including pre-existing /login). Frontend pages of this feature rely on data-testid only; use testID (RNW maps it on some primitives) or accessibilityLabel if automated selectors are desired. Tests had to fall back to Arabic text selectors.

verify_card(): returns the full student payload (name, enrollment no, faculty) for expired/alumni cards on a fully public endpoint — acceptable for verification, but consider trimming PII when valid=false

_card_payload/_ensure_card writes a new card_token on every academic-year change (correct), but /verify/card compares s['card_academic_year'] to the active year; students never opened in the card page keep old tokens (expected behaviour, documented)

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows pass; only static-export 404 status issue)
